_doc: P6-6A Task 12: C-20 PSV API 2000 7th atmospheric tank venting vs Worley 真实算例 WS-CA-PR-024 首次对账 fixture。Calculation Sheet: Atmospheric and Low Pressure Tank Venting (API Standard 2000). ⚠️ SINGLE SCENARIO OVERLAP + AIR-EQUIVALENT CONVERSION MISMATCH — Ruling 8. Direct overlap (FIRE scenario only): Q_W = 43192·F·A_wet^0.82 SI (XLS F19=13958413.732670628 W for A_wet=1148.6448139687682 m², F=1.0) — PCS gives 13955828.84 W (0.0185% diff, within 经验 1%). Out-of-scope: Q_m3_h in Nm³/h of AIR (XLS F24 uses air-equivalent conversion Q_W/(L·ρ_air) — Ruling 8); NORMAL scenario (delegates to breathing_valve_service); thermal venting; max outflow/inflow; tank capacity; flash point; wetted area calc; head type table; multiple scenarios; elevation/liquid level; Pcrit critical flow.

mapping_defect._doc: P6-6A plan 表格行 12 写 'C-20 024 psv/(API 2000 breathing) 经验 1%'. XLS-PR-024 = Atmospheric and Low Pressure Tank Venting (Combined: Emergency FIRE + Normal + Thermal venting) with 11 sub-features; PCS service calc_api2000_relief_capacity = API 2000 7th FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL 4 scenarios per SPEC §3.5.1 V1.4. **SINGLE SCENARIO OVERLAP** (FIRE only): Q_W = 43192·F·A^0.82 SI matches XLS F19=13958413.732670628 W within 经验 1% (0.0185% diff). **AIR-EQUIVALENT CONVERSION MISMATCH** (Ruling 8): XLS F24=67259.06 Nm³/h of AIR uses Q_W/(L·ρ_air) conversion (gas-equivalent volume flow); PCS Q_m3_h = Q_W × 0.86 (simple W → m³/h conversion, no gas basis). Different unit basis — OUT_OF_SCOPE for direct match.
mapping_defect.xls_scope: XLS-PR-024 covers 11 features on Calculation Sheet: (1) Vessel type/geometry (F11-F16: horizontal tank D=15000mm L=25000mm, elevation=5000mm, head type=1.0); (2) Design pressure (F17=0.1 barg); (3) Wetted area computation (F18=1148.64 m² computed from geometry via P8-S28 tables); (4) Fire heat input Q_W (F19=13958413.73 W); (5) Env factor F (F20=1.0); (6) Latent heat L (F21=334.9 kJ/kg); (7) Relieving vapour temp T (F22=15.6 °C); (8) MW (F23=86.17 g/mol); (9) Air-equivalent venting (F24=67259.06 Nm³/h of AIR); (10) Normal venting F28/F30/F32 (max liquid movement); (11) Thermal venting F34/F36 + Total Normal Venting F38. Plus Table sheet with head type areas (Q24-S28).
mapping_defect.pcs_scope: PCS service calc_api2000_relief_capacity: FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL 4 scenarios per SPEC §3.5.1 V1.4. Takes Api2000ReliefInput (frozen dataclass): tank_volume_m3, wetted_area_m2, design_pressure_kpa, vacuum_pressure_kpa, fire_heat_input_w, vessel_geometry, environment_factor, scenario, imperial_units. Returns Api2000ReliefResult: required_relief_rate_w, required_relief_rate_m3_h, scenario_used, formula_used, imperial_conversion, formula_ref. FIRE formula: Q_W = 43192·F·A^0.82 SI (strict conversion from imperial 21000·F·A_ft2^0.82 × 0.293071). Q_m3_h = Q_W × 0.86 (simple W → m³/h conversion for dual-unit output).
mapping_defect.implication: XLS-PR-024 covers 11 features (Emergency + Normal + Thermal venting + geometry); PCS service covers 4 scenarios (FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL). **Direct overlap = FIRE scenario only**: Q_W formula matches XLS F19 within 经验 1% (0.0185% actual diff). **Out of overlap (Ruling 8)**: Q_m3_h air-equivalent conversion mismatch (XLS F24=67259 uses Q_W/(L·ρ_air) gas-equivalent basis; PCS Q_m3_h=Q_W×0.86 simple W conversion — different basis); NORMAL scenario (delegates to breathing_valve_service); thermal venting; max liquid movement; tank capacity; flash point; wetted area calc; head type table; multiple scenarios; elevation/liquid level; Pcrit critical flow. 经验 1% 容差 per SPEC §5 applies to direct overlap fields only (Q_W, formula_used, scenario_used).

tolerance_policy.per_case_note: 本批因 Ruling 8 single scenario overlap — PCS FIRE formula 与 XLS F19 同式，容差 经验 1% per SPEC §5。Q_W 实际 diff = 0.0185%（XLS=13958413.732670628 W vs PCS=13955828.8412 W），within 经验 1%。Q_m3_h 完全 OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8 (air-equivalent conversion mismatch). scenario_used EXACT bool; formula_used EXACT string match; imperial_conversion (None for SI test).

XLS computes Q=13958413.732670628 W (F19, fire heat input) for Awet=1148.6448139687682 m², F=1.0, design pressure 0.1 barg. PCS service calc_api2000_relief_capacity computes Q_W = 43192 × 1.0 × 1148.6448139687682^0.82 = 13955828.84 W (0.0185% diff vs XLS F19, within 经验 1%). root_cause_notes.finding: XLS-PR-024 covers 11 features on Calculation Sheet (Emergency + Normal + Thermal venting + geometry + project metadata); PCS service calc_api2000_relief_capacity covers 4 scenarios (FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL). **SINGLE SCENARIO OVERLAP** — only FIRE scenario has direct numerical overlap (Q_W = 43192·F·A^0.82 SI). XLS F19=13958413.732670628 W; PCS=13955828.84 W (0.0185% diff, within 经验 1%). **AIR-EQUIVALENT CONVERSION MISMATCH** (Ruling 8 — main finding): XLS F24=67259.06 Nm³/h of AIR uses gas-equivalent volume flow basis Q_W/(L·ρ_air) with L=334.9 kJ/kg and ρ_air=1.293 kg/Nm³ (standard conditions). PCS Q_m3_h = Q_W × 0.86 (simple W → m³/h conversion with no gas basis assumption). These are DIFFERENT physical quantities — PCS uses a dimensionless conversion factor, XLS uses thermodynamic gas-equivalent basis. Direct Q_m3_h match OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8; only Q_W (W) within 经验 1% 容差.

XLS F38 = 639.0 Nm³/h of AIR (Total Normal Venting Capacity Required, AIR-equivalent basis — F29/F30/F32 liquid movement inputs). PCS service NORMAL scenario delegates to breathing_valve_service (separate API; not implemented in calc_api2000_relief_capacity, returns Q=0 placeholder). Register: NORMAL scenario F38 direct match OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F34 = 183.49 Nm³/h (thermal inbreathing, best-fit curve equation), F35 = 169.0 (selected), F36 = 'obtain from graph or table' (text), F37 = 101.0 (selected). XLS derives thermal venting from best-fit curve equations (Note 2: 'Based on the best fit curve equation. Rather than use this value, the user may elect to obtain a value from the graph or table.'). PCS service doesn't implement thermal venting separately (FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL only). Register: thermal venting OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F28 = 500.0 m³/h (Maximum outflow of liquid from tank), F30 = 500.0 m³/h (Maximum inflow of liquid to tank). These are inputs to XLS normal venting calculation (F29/F32 derived from F28/F30 + tank capacity). PCS service doesn't handle normal venting liquid movement scenarios. Register: max outflow/inflow OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F33 = 1000.0 m³ (Tank capacity, input to normal venting calculation). PCS service takes tank_volume_m3 as input (for F2 >0 validation) but doesn't use it in FIRE formula. Register: tank capacity F33 OUT_OF_SCOPE for FIRE scenario direct match (only used for input validation).

XLS F31 = 1.0 (Flash or boiling point criteria — selection code: 'if both available, use flash point'); P42/P43 = 'F.P>37.8 or B.P>148.9 °C' / 'F.P<37.8 or B.P<149 °C' (criteria thresholds). These are XLS normal venting selection criteria. PCS service has no flash point logic. Register: flash point criteria OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS computes Awet from vessel geometry via Table sheet (P8-S28: 75% of total surface area for horizontal vessel; head wetted areas Q24-S28: flat=79.40, semi-elliptical=110.19, torispherical=85.12, hemispherical=158.81 m²; T22 = 1148.64 m² for horizontal). PCS service takes Awet as INPUT (wetted_area_m2) OR calls C-12 calc_wetted_area when vessel_geometry is provided (D7 接口冻结). For this test, Awet is passed directly (no vessel_geometry) since XLS already provides the computed value F18=1148.64 m². Register: wetted area calc table OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS uses pre-computed value or C-12 service.

XLS Table sheet Q24-S28 pre-computed head wetted areas: flat (Q25=79.40 m²), semi-ellipsoidal (Q26=110.19 m²), torispherical (Q27=85.12 m²), hemispherical (Q28=158.81 m²). XLS uses F15=1.0 (flat head) for horizontal vessel. PCS service uses C-12 calc_wetted_area (D7 接口冻结) which computes head areas from vessel geometry (head_type='flat'/'2:1_ELLIPTICAL'/etc.). For this test, Awet is passed directly without vessel_geometry. Register: head type table OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS uses C-12 service.

XLS PR-024 covers FIRE (Q_W = 13958413.73 W), NORMAL (F38 = 639 Nm³/h AIR), Thermal (F34-F37). PCS service implements 4 scenarios (FIRE/VACUUM/EMERGENCY/NORMAL) per SPEC §3.5.1 V1.4. This test covers FIRE only per Ruling 8 single scenario overlap. VACUUM scenario (Q = 1013·A) and EMERGENCY scenario (Q = 1.5 × FIRE) not tested here. Register: multiple scenarios OUT_OF_SCOPE — only FIRE has direct overlap.

XLS F14 = 5000.0 mm = 5.0 m (Elevation of base above grade). XLS uses elevation in Awet computation (T22 = 1148.64 m² 'based on 75% of total surface area' — accounts for partial base exposure). F22 = 15.6 °C (relieving vapour temp) is normal venting input. PCS service takes Awet directly as input (no elevation/liquid level computation). Register: elevation/liquid level OUT_OF_SCOPE — passed via computed Awet.

API 2000 7th atmospheric tank venting does NOT involve critical flow (Pcrit) calculations — venting is driven by heat input (FIRE) or liquid movement (NORMAL), not by choked flow through an orifice. XLS PR-024 has no Pcrit/Ftp critical flow section (unlike PR-023 blowdown orifice which does). Register: Pcrit critical flow OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8 (concept not applicable to API 2000 scope).

out_of_scope.rationale: Ruling 8 — AIR-EQUIVALENT CONVERSION MISMATCH: XLS F24=67259.06 Nm³/h of AIR uses Q_W/(L·ρ_air) with L=334.9 kJ/kg and ρ_air=1.293 kg/Nm³. PCS Q_m3_h = Q_W × 0.86 (dimensionless simple W conversion). Different physical quantities (thermodynamic gas-equivalent vs dimensionless). Direct Q_m3_h match OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8; only Q_W (W) within 经验 1% 容差.

XLS F38 = 639.0 Nm³/h of AIR (Total Normal Venting Capacity Required). PCS NORMAL scenario delegates to breathing_valve_service (separate API; returns Q=0 placeholder in calc_api2000_relief_capacity). OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F34=183.49 Nm³/h (thermal inbreathing best-fit curve), F35=169.0 (selected), F36='obtain from graph or table' (text), F37=101.0 (selected). PCS service doesn't implement thermal venting separately. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.
XLS F28=500 m³/h (max outflow), F30=500 m³/h (max inflow). Normal venting inputs (liquid movement). PCS service doesn't handle normal venting liquid movement scenarios. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F33=1000.0 m³ (tank capacity, normal venting input). PCS service takes tank_volume_m3 for F2 validation (>0) but doesn't use it in FIRE formula. Tank capacity F33 OUT_OF_SCOPE for direct match (only used for input validation).

XLS F31=1.0 (selection code), P42/P43='F.P>37.8 or B.P>148.9 °C' / 'F.P<37.8 or B.P<149 °C' (criteria thresholds). XLS normal venting selection logic. PCS service has no flash point logic. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS computes Awet from geometry via Table sheet P8-S28 (75% of total surface area for horizontal). PCS service takes Awet as input (wetted_area_m2) OR calls C-12 calc_wetted_area (D7 接口冻结) when vessel_geometry is provided. Wetted area computation table OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS uses pre-computed value or C-12 service.

XLS Table sheet Q24-S28 pre-computed head wetted areas for 4 head types (flat=79.40, semi-ellipsoidal=110.19, torispherical=85.12, hemispherical=158.81 m²). PCS service uses C-12 calc_wetted_area (D7 接口冻结) which computes head areas from vessel geometry (head_type='flat'/'2:1_ELLIPTICAL'/etc.). Head type table OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS uses C-12 service.

XLS PR-024 covers FIRE (F19), NORMAL (F38), Thermal (F34-F37). PCS service implements 4 scenarios but only FIRE has direct overlap with XLS PR-024 per Ruling 8 single scenario overlap. VACUUM (Q=1013·A), EMERGENCY (Q=1.5×FIRE), NORMAL, Thermal scenarios not tested here. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

XLS F14=5000 mm (elevation of base above grade), F22=15.6 °C (relieving vapour temp). XLS uses elevation in Awet computation (75% of total accounts for partial base exposure). PCS service takes Awet directly as input — no elevation/liquid level computation. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8.

API 2000 7th atmospheric tank venting doesn't involve critical flow (Pcrit) calculations — venting is driven by heat input or liquid movement. XLS PR-024 has no Pcrit/Ftp critical flow section. Register: Pcrit critical flow OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 8 (concept not applicable).
